document: AC009 native event/method universe for the locally installed OpenAI Codex CLI
method_statement: Every name below was OBSERVED against the installed 0.154.0 binary: invoked live over JSON-RPC stdio, received live as a stdout event, or enumerated verbatim by the server itself in a -32600 unknown-variant error (authoritative for this binary). No docs-inferred names are included. Rollout line types were read from rollout JSONL files produced by live runs.

app_server_client_requests_invoked_live.note: params {clientInfo:{name,version[,title]}}; result {userAgent, codexHome, platformFamily:'unix', platformOs:'linux'}; missing clientInfo -> -32600 'Invalid request: missing field `clientInfo`'

provider-free with empty params; returns Thread object {id, sessionId (same value), environments, status:{type:'idle'}, model:'gpt-6-astra', historyMode:'paginated', path, createdAt,...} and emits thread/started notification; NO model call
paginated {data:[Thread], nextCursor, backwardsCursor}; entries notLoaded in metadata-only listing
required threadId; excludeTurns:true returns metadata + effective config WITHOUT turns or model call; unknown id -> -32600 'no rollout found for thread id <id>'
returns ids of threads loaded in this server process
returns catalog entries (id, displayName, supportedReasoningEfforts, ...) without a model call
result {account:null, requiresOpenaiAuth:true} under isolated CODEX_HOME without auth
on missing thread -> -32600 'thread not found: <id>'; NOT exercised with a live turn in AC009 (probe budget)
required {threadId, turnId}; on missing thread -> -32600 'thread not found: <id>'; NOT exercised against a live turn

app_server_server_notifications_observed.trigger: unprompted, after thread/start; params {thread: Thread, emittedAtMs}
unprompted, at connection setup; params {status:'disabled', serverName, installationId, environmentId}

exec_json_stdout_event_types_observed_li.note: emitted on fresh exec AND on exec resume (same id as original thread)
exec stdout showed only agent_message and error item types; commandExecution items were NOT surfaced on stdout

rollout_jsonl_line_types_observed_live.fields: session_id, id, timestamp, cwd, originator, cli_version, source, thread_source, model_provider, base_instructions, history_mode, context_window
rollout_jsonl_line_types_observed_live.note: first line; session_id == id == thread UUID == filename UUID

task_complete carries last_agent_message, started_at, completed_at, duration_ms, time_to_first_token_ms, and error on failure; token_count carries total/last token usage + rate_limits + model_context_window
custom_tool_call_output embeds exit_code and sandbox-denial stderr text
